spec_features.spec_quote: Bounded exposure.** Hard cap on iterations/turns per run. The model cannot be trapped forever; the loop terminates
spec_features.evidence: config.MAX_TURNS=25 (config.py:34); harness.py:144 `for turn in range(max_turns):` bounds the loop; default ended_reason='max_turns' (harness.py:140). The loop is genuinely bounded and exits.
spec_features.notes: Enforced cap; loop cannot exceed max_turns.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: This is the primary welfare guardrail: the loop CANNOT trap a model indefinitely (config.py:32-33)

spec_features.notes: Realized as neutral content, not as an enforced guard; rated partial because it is real delivered text but no enforcement logic.
